# Project Governance 3.0.0-rc.10.9

Resumed native prompts can prepare context while a prior startup process remains alive. The new
prompt holds its own verified current-generation reader; startup/update ownership remains intact.

- Preserve the inherited conversation identity in ordinary context receipts. Report missing native
  entry separately from a successful explicit task-bound request.
- Verify exact native packet replay without a provider call. Session, source, task, runtime and
  newest-turn validation remain active; no command shortcut guesses which turn the caller means.
- Distinguish malformed supplied references from malformed stored identities. Record safe failure
  stages, cause codes and identity digests without raw prompts, reference values or exception text.
- Retain the earlier local candidate's repairs for large consultation receipts, context-specific
  review refusal, managed check recovery and recorded helper shutdown.

Local qualification includes regression cases that failed before correction, native process and
ownership tests, type checking and clean compiled installation. The installed native-parent and
provider cases use deterministic fixtures. This release does not claim accepted-task token savings
or fresh live-provider proof.

This is an operator-authorized manual prerelease. Hosted CI is skipped. Adopter upgrades remain
deliberate; publication does not reattach conversations, release owners or waive application checks.
